entities.name: Skrelv
entities.description: A Phyrexian Mite on New Phyrexia, only a foot tall with a sharp bite, defective and worthless by Machine Orthodoxy standards but who has evaded being recycled.

entities.name: Machine Orthodoxy
entities.description: The mighty Phyrexian order by whose standards Skrelv is worthless.

events.summary: Skrelv evaded being recycled through cleverness, luck and his small stature.
events.quote: he has managed to evade being recycled
